title.narrative: Second Kenya Social and Economic Inclusion Project

description.narrative: The development objective of the Second Kenya Social and Economic Inclusion Project is to promote economic resilience of poor and vulnerable households and strengthen the adaptive social protection system. This project has four components. The first component, Building Human Capital of Children and Adolescents, has the following sub-components: Building Human Capital of Children under Three Years through Nutrition; and Building Human Capital of Adolescents. The second component, Building Climate and Economic Resilience of Adults, has the following sub-components: Climate Resilient Economic Inclusion Program; Enhanced Climate Resilient EIP in the Most Affected Counties; and Economic Resilience through Social Insurance Schemes. The third component, Advancing Systems and Strengthening Adaptive Social Protection, has the following sub-components: Advancing the Enhanced Single Registry; Strengthening the Consolidated Cash Transfer Program; and Strengthening HSNP for Enhanced Climate-Shock Responsiveness. The fourth component, Project Management, Monitoring and Evaluation, and Policy and Legislation, will finance project management, including capacity building, M&E, and environmental and social (E&S) risk management for both implementing agencies (IAs).
